description: This file defines the base exception class `Error` for Twig templates, handling error details, source context, and debugging aids within the Twig template engine.

classes.name: Twig\Error\Error
classes.description: A custom exception class for errors occurring during Twig template loading, syntax errors, or rendering, which tracks template name, line, source code, and path.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Error object with a message, optional line number, optional source context, and previous exception; sets internal state accordingly.

methods.name: getRawMessage
methods.description: Returns the raw error message string.

methods.name: getTemplateLine
methods.description: Returns the line number in the template where the error occurred.

methods.name: setTemplateLine
methods.description: Sets the line number where the error occurred and updates the error message.

methods.name: getSourceContext
methods.description: Returns a Source object representing the source code, name, and path of the template, if available.

methods.name: setSourceContext
methods.description: Sets the source code, name, and path from a Source object, or clears them if null.

methods.name: guess
methods.description: Attempts to infer template information such as name and source path via debugging backtrace.

methods.name: appendMessage
methods.description: Appends additional text to the raw error message.

methods.name: updateRepr
methods.description: Updates the full error message string based on current properties, formatting it with context.

methods.name: guessTemplateInfo
methods.description: Guesses template name, source code, and path by inspecting the debug backtrace and associated template object.
